blocks.text: Prime • New on Amazon in past month

Stable structure:
Our peony support rings feature a grid framework design, more effectively guiding the direction of stem and leaf growth and preventing lodging. Easy to remove and reuse, detachable design, saves space, and easy to store.

Sturdy and easy to use:
These plant support stakes are guaranteed to hold your plants straight, made with premium iron and powder coating for enhanced sturdiness. Each stake can be adjusted to 24" or 9", allowing for customized plant support.

Basic Information:
Quantity: 6
Color: green
Size: 24 x 12 inch/ 60 x 30 cm
Material: iron

Package includes:
6 x Metal peony support cage

Notes:
Due to manual measurement, sizes may vary slightly.
Due to screen display, product color may be slightly different from the picture

items.label: Package Contains
items.value: you will receive 6 pack peony support stakes to meet your support needs; Each set bracket consists of a grid top and 8 leg supports, which is stable and sturdy; The leg support need to be assembled from four sections and can also be disassembled to adjust the height; The plant peony cage are designed to provide reliable support, ensuring that your carefully cultivated plants remain upright and grow vigorously

items.label: Adjustable Height and Suitable Size
items.value: the peony plant support features a mesh disc with a diameter of 12 inches; The garden support stake has legs assembled from two sections, offering two height options: 24 inches and 9 inches; For young peony plants, the 9 inch height can be supplied initially, allowing the stems to naturally grow through the wire grid; As the plants grow, add the extension stakes to reach 24 inches; The circular shape and size can effectively prevent vine spread

items.label: Quality Material
items.value: the round plant support cage is made entirely of sturdy and durable iron, is weather-resistant, reusable, and long-lasting even when used under sun and rain; It's not easy to deform, stand firmly, and well support and protect plants

items.label: Simple Assembly
items.value: our peony support cage ring is installed through screws and threads, easy to assemble and not easily damaged by external forces; Just fix the 4 leg supports on the of the grid top according to the instructions; Insert 4 leg braces into the base soil around the plant to be protected for at least 4 inches; This will protect plants from strong wind and rainstorms; In the off-season, these peony cage stakes can be easily disassembled, providing convenient storage

items.label: Plant Support Cages
items.value: the grow through grid plant support has the function of providing great support and protecting the healthy growth of plants; It can serve as an effective stem support, providing stability for a variety of plants, from outdoor flower beds to indoor greenhouses; Perfect support for growing peony, rose, hydrangea, tomato, and begonia
